hint.text: An expanded noun phrase is a phrase that adds detail to nouns with adjectives and prepositional phrases. Expanded noun phrases can convey information more concisely.

b: ++two dainty, playful songbirds on the tree stump
There are two dainty, playful songbirds. They are on the tree stump.

instruction.text: Find the two adjectives in the expanded noun phrase.

atoms.b: two ((dainty)), ((playful)) songbirds on the tree stump

b: ++one shiny, tiny goldfish in the tank
A shiny, tiny goldfish is inside the tank.

instruction.text: Find the determiner in the expanded noun phrase.

hint.text: A determiner is a word that introduces a noun, such as 'a', 'the', 'one' or 'several'.

atoms.b: ((one)) shiny, tiny goldfish in the tank

b: ++an experienced, confident pilot at the front of the aircraft
The experienced, confident pilot was at the front of the aircraft.

instruction.text: Find the noun that the adjectives refer to in the expanded noun phrase.

atoms.b: an experienced, confident ((pilot)) at the front of the aircraft

b: ++several round, smooth pebbles in someone’s hand
There are several round, smooth pebbles. They are in someone’s hand.

instruction.text: Find the prepositional phrase in the expanded noun phrase.

atoms.b: several round, smooth pebbles ((in someone’s hand))
